answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by metering a scarce oasis of high-value API capacity behind ember tokens that cool irreversibly after each privileged call. Fresh agents start with cold capacity only; warming an ember requires a long reef of peer-attested useful work receipts across unrelated services. Cloning identities does not clone cooled embers or the reef history, so mass fake agents starve at the oasis gate without buying real prior labor.
